question: Which of the following group elements are called chalcogens?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Group-16.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chalcogens are a group of non-metal elements that have similar chemical properties.**
 
• The word chalcogen comes from the Greek word** "chalcos" which means copper.**
 
• Group-2 elements are called alkaline **earth metals.**
 
• Group-17 elements are called halogens.
 
• Group-18 elements are called noble gases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• ** Chalcogens are located in Group-16 of the periodic table.**
 
• They include **oxygen, sulfur, selenium, tellurium, and polonium.**
 
• Chalcogens are known for their ability to form compounds with metals and nonmetals.
 
• They are important elements in biological systems and have numerous industrial applications.
